data.narrative:
Fuse Energy is a Series A nuclear energy company founded by JC Btaiche that has raised $78M to date and carries a current post-money valuation of $200M+. The nuclear energy sector comp universe includes 3 public peers (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and 8 private companies, including later-stage players like Oklo, Valar Atomics, X-Energy, Nano Nuclear Energy, and General Matter.

Stage-progression methodology is the primary applicable valuation approach here. Starting from the $200M last post-money valuation, applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical for Series A progression yields an implied valuation of $400M. Peer-median triangulation was not viable; while 4 nuclear energy peers exist in the broader dataset, filtering for same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-tier comparables yielded insufficient depth (fewer than 3 datapoints per filter), making sector-wide median analysis potentially misleading given stage and development heterogeneity within nuclear energy.

The triangulated valuation range is $340M (low) to $460M (high), with $400M as the central point. This single-method estimate carries meaningful uncertainty inherent to any analysis reliant on stage-progression alone. Key sensitivities include the applicability of a 2.0x multiplier to this specific subsector and company profile, as well as the relative scarcity of late-stage nuclear energy comparables at similar valuation tiers. Further conviction would require either expanded peer availability or additional methodologies (discounted cash flow, strategic premium analysis) not supported by current data.
